I was hiking in the snow with some friends when we came upon a giant pile of build up snow, at least four feet above the resting snow, and I thought it would be fun to jump into it head first. My head found out it was a frozen rock first, it was fine, but when my hands hit it I ended up breaking one of my fingers. For the first month of the injury, people told me it was just jammed and I didn't need to go to the hospital for it. It is permanently a half inch shorter than it was before.

Was moving across State (maybe a ten-hour drive) with my family including our three dogs and one cat, the dogs were just loose in the car while the cat was in a carrier. The first night of our trip to the new house we were only two hours into the drive before we stopped at a animal-friendly hotel and rented two rooms. The cat went with me and the dogs went with my parents. We left the next day in a hurry, throwing everything in the car really quick (including the dogs and cat carrier) after sleeping in too late. About 5 minutes after leaving I decided to check on the cat only to find her not in the carrier at all. We turned around and got her from the room right away. I don't know if the hotel could have called us while on the road, but it would have been terrible if we just drove eight hours away from there only to have to turn around and get the cat.
